tokens.name: kd-paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Everything sits on paper; there are no cards behind sections.

tokens.name: kd-paper-2
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: product image wells, the prescription band, the current-month column, the next plan step.

tokens.name: kd-paper-3
tokens.usage: Pressed / disabled fills, the empty cart count.

tokens.name: kd-sheet
tokens.usage: The things you write on or print on: inputs, the analysis label, the prescription slip, menus.

tokens.name: kd-ink
tokens.usage: Text and every structural rule (section heads, label borders, calendar frame). 15.9:1 on kd-paper.

tokens.name: kd-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, table labels. 8.4:1 on kd-paper, 7.6:1 on kd-paper-2.

tokens.name: kd-ink-3
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, counts. 5.7:1 on kd-paper, 5.2:1 on kd-paper-2, 4.5:1 on kd-paper-3.

tokens.name: kd-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and cells. Decorative separation only (1.4:1) — never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: kd-field
tokens.usage: The one brand colour: primary buttons, links, the selected tab underline, focus outline. Paper text on it is 9:1.

tokens.name: kd-field-2
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed state of kd-field.

tokens.name: kd-field-3
tokens.usage: Quiet selection: the active crop row in the almanac.

tokens.name: kd-n
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY — nitrogen in analysis bars, element table and almanac marks. White text on it 5.1:1.

tokens.name: kd-p
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY — phosphorus. 3.5:1 on paper: use as a mark or bar, never as text on paper.

tokens.name: kd-k
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY — potassium; also the accent digit on the 404 page. 5.7:1 on paper.

tokens.name: kd-o
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY — organic matter / humus marks in the almanac; footer strata.

tokens.name: kd-m
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY — micronutrients (Fe, Zn, Ca, B, Mn, S, Mg) marks.

tokens.name: kd-ok
tokens.usage: In-stock dot. Always next to a word.

tokens.name: kd-warn
tokens.usage: Low-stock text and dot («فقط ۳ عدد مانده»). 5.5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: kd-err
tokens.usage: Field errors and error notices. 6:1 on paper.

families.ui: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: هر خاک، کودِ خودش را می‌خواهد.
styles.usage: Homepage headline only. One per site.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles, always above a 1px kd-ink rule.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Panel titles, the analysis label name.

styles.name: index
styles.usage: Rows of the category index; crop names in the almanac (22px).

styles.name: label-code
styles.usage: The guaranteed analysis on the hero label. Latin digits on purpose: it is what is printed on the bag.

styles.name: element
styles.usage: Chemical symbols in the element table.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: N-P-K on shelf items, SKUs, atomic numbers.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: بگویید چه می‌کارید؛ کود و زمان مصرفش را ما پیشنهاد می‌دهیم.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: کودهای آلی کند اثر می‌کنند اما بافت خاک را می‌سازند.

styles.name: item-title
styles.usage: Product names on the shelf (max two lines).

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices: Persian digits, Persian thousands separator, 'تومان' at 11px kd-ink-3.

tokens.name: kd-s-1
tokens.usage: Tag inner gaps.

tokens.name: kd-s-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: kd-s-3
tokens.usage: Compact list padding.

tokens.name: kd-s-4
tokens.usage: Default control padding; mobile shelf cell padding.

tokens.name: kd-s-5
tokens.usage: Shelf cell padding (desktop).

tokens.name: kd-s-6
tokens.usage: Gap between tabs; promise padding.

tokens.name: kd-s-8
tokens.usage: Head rule to content; slip padding.

tokens.name: kd-s-10
tokens.usage: Column gap of split layouts; route padding.

tokens.name: kd-s-12
tokens.usage: Between header and page body.

tokens.name: kd-s-16
tokens.usage: Hero top padding; gap between hero columns.

tokens.name: kd-s-24
tokens.usage: Largest vertical pause.

tokens.name: kd-r-1
tokens.usage: Tags, image wells, calendar marks — nearly square on purpose.

tokens.name: kd-r-2
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: kd-r-3
tokens.usage: Reserved for overlays (drawer). Nothing larger exists in the system.

tokens.name: kd-pop
tokens.usage: The only shadow: menus and the drawer, things that float above the page.
